title: Marketing Manager
motivazione: Il candidato ha solide competenze in marketing/sales strategico, go-to-market e gestione portfolio, ma manca il requisito esplicito di 5+ anni in ruolo simile e l'esperienza specifica nel settore B2B nutraceutico/industriale richiesta. Il profilo è più orientato a digital/growth in startup e PMI tech, mentre qui serve competitive intelligence su prodotti fisici, R&D e regulatory affairs, ambiti non presenti nel CV.

Developing marketing communication materials in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Conducting competitive intelligence and market monitoring, tracking industry trends, competitors' activities, new product launches, and emerging opportunities. Analyzing market trends, customer insights, and competitive dynamics to support portfolio and business decisions. Acting as a key liaison between R&D, Sales, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, and other internal stakeholders to ensure successful product development and commercialization. Contributing to the launch and lifecycle management of new and existing products. Profile We are looking for a proactive, strategic and market-oriented professional with strong analytical skills, excellent cross-functional collaboration capabilities, and the ability to translate customer and market insights into profitable growth opportunities. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Mission You will be responsible for managing the KNX offer and defining the best marketing strategy for the Italian market. A constant cooperation with local sales teams, suppliers and tendering will be required, in addition to frequent exchange with the Global Business Unit in English. You will join the marketing team in Italy Country Organization as Offer Manager and you will take a deep interest in developing and updating tools to support sales team and customers, understanding Italian customers’ needs, competitors benchmark and price positioning, training and customer presentations. You will work closely with all the company departments, including quality and finance. What will you do? Based on Offer and Italian Market knowledge, you will: Assess the competitive landscape to create benchmarks, define price strategy and influence Global projects held by Business unit according to Italian market needs Work closely with the rest of the marketing (channels and offer) to shape the go-to-market strategy Support local pre-sales and commercial teams to boost the offer through different Channel with a huge collaboration with Distributors, Design Firms and Sell-out Channel Managers Be responsible for the performance (financial, engagement, satisfaction) of the ranges in the portfolio Identify actions to increase the performances of the offer in the Italian market based on data analysis Define and deploy launch plans for the new products, including tailored trainings and presentations on sales team and customers What skills and capabilities will make you successful? Team Worker: synergies are mandatory to perform Technical Background in KNX and/or Building Automation Passionate for customers and business Comfortable with digital tools Interdisciplinary thinker with synthesis capability Analytical mindset, comfortable working with data Fluent English Permanent Contract; Exciting job in an international company, with opportunities o lead and contribute to different projects collaborating with cross-region teams; Special training tailored to your needs and career goals; Opportunity to develop based on clear career paths, to grow through experience and exposure; An environment where employees have equal opportunities to reach their fullest potential, depending on performance and personal aspirations; Global Family Leave program; Ticket restaurant or meal at canteen; Shareholding plans; Welfare programs that can be extended to your family; Health insurance and Professional/extraprofessional accident insurance.
